items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Buchanan had promised me to bring a band into the Savoy... he would use me as the house band

ctx.x: I went in to the Savoy -- Mr. Buchanan had promised me to bring a band into the Savoy, and if the dancers liked the band, he would use me as the house band because the Savoy Sultans had broken up, and they were looking for a small band to take their place.
It was a small band, then, huh?
